name: Continuation Grammar and Compositional Structure Law
purpose: Define bounded grammar rules for composing continuation-law structures.

candidate_law_statement.informal: The framework requires grammar rules that specify which continuation structures can combine, in what order, under what admissibility constraints, and with what preserved failure modes.

formal.symbol_set: Σ_C := {δ, Π_A, NavT, CSI, C_P, B_U, Arb_A, Ξ, D_A, Top_A}
formal.composition_rule_candidate: Comp_C(X,Y) is permitted only if domain/codomain compatibility, admissibility preservation, budget constraints, and reconstruction limits are satisfied.
formal.reduction_rule_candidate: Reduce_C(expr) may simplify a continuation expression only when failure modes, branch ambiguity, and boundedness conditions are preserved.
formal.invalid_composition_condition: Invalid_C(X,Y) occurs when composition hides failure modes, forces uniqueness, erases reconstruction loss, exceeds budget, or introduces primitive geometry/time/law assumptions.
formal.grammar_scope_clause: The grammar is local, provisional, extensible, and governance-bound rather than universal or complete.
